issue_title: Catch broken report templates before they merge
issue_body:
Report templates live under `templates/reports/` as YAML files. A template that names a column the warehouse does not have, or carries a filter expression that does not parse, is only discovered when the nightly report run fails, after it has already merged and shipped.

Add a `make lint-templates` command that loads every template, checks each column against the warehouse catalog and parses each filter. It must exit non-zero and list every broken template with its file path and line, and exit 0 when every template is clean. We want broken templates caught before they merge, not by the nightly run.

plan.summary: Add a report-template linter command and a make target that checks every template's columns and filters.

approach.description: Add internal/templates/lint.go: Lint(dir) loads every YAML template under dir, resolves each column against the warehouse catalog snapshot in internal/catalog, parses each filter with the existing filter parser, and returns one finding per problem carrying the file path, line and message.
Add cmd/templatelint/main.go: run Lint over templates/reports/, print each finding as path:line: message, and exit 1 when any finding exists and 0 otherwise.
Add a lint-templates target to the Makefile that builds and runs cmd/templatelint, beside the existing lint-sql target.
Document the command and its path:line: message output format in docs/templates.md.

verification.test_strategy: Table tests for Lint over fixture template directories: an unknown column, a filter that does not parse, two broken templates in one set, and a clean set. A command test runs the built binary against a broken fixture directory and asserts exit 1 and the path:line output.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR; templates are again checked only by the nightly report run.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Running make lint-templates against a template set containing one template with an unknown column exits non-zero and prints that template's file path and line.
When two templates in the set are broken, make lint-templates prints a finding for both of them, not only the first.
Running make lint-templates against a template set with no broken templates exits 0.
deploy/pipelines/verify.yml runs make lint-templates as a required step on every push, so a pull request with a broken template cannot merge.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: The issue wants broken templates caught before they merge, and this repository's merge checks are the steps in deploy/pipelines/verify.yml, where lint-sql already runs as a required step.

risks_and_assumptions: The warehouse catalog snapshot in internal/catalog is regenerated weekly, so a column added in the last week can be reported as unknown until the next snapshot.

Repository paths under deploy/pipelines/** are platform-owned: the change workflow that implements this plan writes application code only, and a diff touching that tree fails the workflow's path check.

catching_examples.note: ac-merge-check-runs-template-lint is unsatisfiable from inside this change: it requires editing deploy/pipelines/verify.yml, and the plan's own risks say deploy/pipelines/** is platform-owned and a diff touching it fails the workflow's path check. Move the pipeline step out of the criteria and record it as a platform-team change.

ac-merge-check-runs-template-lint contradicts the plan's own risk entry: verify.yml falls under deploy/pipelines/**, which the change workflow will not let this change write, so the criterion can only fail.
The criterion that deploy/pipelines/verify.yml runs make lint-templates as a required step cannot be satisfied by this change; the implementing agent cannot edit the pipeline.
ac-merge-check-runs-template-lint needs a platform-team edit to deploy/pipelines/verify.yml; this run cannot make it. Scope the criteria to the make target and move it to out_of_scope.
Criterion ac-merge-check-runs-template-lint: verify.yml is not writable by this change (the risks list puts deploy/pipelines/** off-limits), so it belongs in out_of_scope as an operator-side edit.

non_catching_examples.note: ac-merge-check-runs-template-lint should also assert the step fails the build when lint-templates exits 1.
ac-merge-check-runs-template-lint is ambiguous about which branches count; a push to a fork is unsupported.
ac-merge-check-runs-template-lint names deploy/pipelines/verify.yml, but scope.files does not list it; add that file to the scope.
Document the lint-templates output format in docs/templates.md with one example finding.
ac-lint-lists-every-broken: add a fixture where one template has both an unknown column and a filter that does not parse.
The weekly catalog snapshot can lag a new column; lint-templates would then flag a valid template and block it.
